name: PANTSIR
desc:
📡Defend, strike and survive.
Operate air defense systems, launch drone strikes and fight over strategic targets in a conflict between Defenders and Operators, or be a civilian and survive the crossfire.

🛑DISCLAIMER⚠️
This game is a work of fiction created for entertainment purposes. It does not promote violence, political ideologies, or reference real-world conflicts. This is not meant to be a training simulator for real-life weapons or devices.

This game is in active development. Updates happen relatively frequently, and you can join our communications server for more information on them.
